metadata.description: grenier — declutter & resell. A collection of Claude Skills to sort your home and turn clutter into things sold, donated or recycled, with local marketplace recipes per country.

plugins.name: grenier
plugins.description: Sort your home, decide what to do with each thing (sell / donate / recycle / trash), and draft the listing. Chains three Skills: declutter -> offload -> sell. English core with FR/US/UK marketplace recipes.
